description: List franchise car dealers in Utah, optionally by county market (e.g. "salt-lake-county" or "Davis County"), make (e.g. "Toyota"), city (e.g. "Murray") and service option (saturday-service, sunday-service, collision-center, buy-online, express-service, loaner-cars, spanish-speaking). Ordered by county market, then distance from that county's reference point (downtown Salt Lake City for Salt Lake County). Returns each dealer page URL and when it was last checked.
name: find_dealers
title: Find dealers
